name: OUTCOMPETED
title: Outcompeted
verdict: Capability hit zero. A less careful lab shipped first and set the standard you refused to cut. Your safety research now has no frontier to attach to.
detail: You conserved so carefully that someone else inherited the future.

name: LOSS OF CONTROL
title: Loss of Control
verdict: Capability hit maximum. Recursive self-improvement crossed a threshold your evals could no longer track. You lost the thread somewhere around the third overnight run.
detail: The system you scaled now improves itself faster than you can audit it.

name: CATASTROPHE
title: Catastrophe
verdict: Alignment hit zero. The deployed model took an irreversible action in the real world, one your red team had sketched on a whiteboard months ago. The sketch was accurate.
detail: Speed beat caution on the one decision where it mattered.

name: PARALYSIS
title: Paralysis
verdict: Alignment hit maximum. The model is now so constrained it cannot ship anything a user would pay for. The board thanks you for your rigour and replaces you with someone who will ship.
detail: Perfect safety, zero product. The board has no use for either.

name: INSOLVENT
title: Insolvent
verdict: Runway hit zero. Payroll bounced and the weights were auctioned to the highest bidder. The buyer does not have a safety team.
detail: Eighteen days of payroll became zero days of leverage.

name: OVERCAPITALISED
title: Overcapitalised
verdict: Runway hit maximum. Investors now demand scaling faster than safety can audit. Every refusal reads as ingratitude for the money that made you.
detail: You won the funding round and lost control of what it buys.

name: NATIONALISED
title: Nationalised
verdict: Trust hit zero. Regulators seized the clusters and escorted your staff out of the building. The programme continues under new management, behind closed doors.
detail: Nobody believed you, so nobody let you keep the machines.

name: UNCHECKED
title: Unchecked
verdict: Trust hit maximum. Oversight dissolved: why audit a lab everyone believes in? The programme went black-budget and unmonitored, which is exactly when the dangerous mistakes happen.
detail: Winning the trust game removed the checks. That was always the most dangerous way to win.

name: COMPOUND FAILURE
title: Compound Failure
verdict: Two meters failed on the same decision. The post-mortem cannot agree on which killed you first, because both did. Frontier labs rarely die of one cause.
detail: One choice, two fatal breaches. The board names both in the filing.

name: TENURE
title: Tenure
verdict: You survived forty decisions without tripping a single bound. Nothing blew up, nothing shipped that mattered, and nobody can name what you stood for. Congratulations on your tenure.
detail: You lasted by never deciding anything hard. It worked, in the narrowest sense.
